test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The guilty are punished by the judge.

options.text: The judge is punishing the guilty.
The judge has been punishing the guilty.
The judge has punished the guilty.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'The judge punishes the guilty.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Passive Voice. As per the question we have to change it into Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V1 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (Objective Case) + is/am/are + V3 + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice) 
 
 

 
• *Example:*

 
 
• *Aastha teaches English. (Active Voice) *
 
• *English is taught by Aastha. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'The guilty'. 
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'the judge'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• 'are punished' will be changed into 'punishes'.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *The judge punishes the guilty.*
